integrity: Proof supplied for all positive integer part sizes within the stated restrictions; exact finite recurrence and interval checker included.
scientific_limitations: Only finite simple unweighted complete multipartite graphs with at least two non-singleton parts, each part of size at least two; no claims for singleton parts, halfspace-only families, or arbitrary graphs. Finite verification is supplementary to the proof; historical priority and independent validation remain open.
title: Exact shattering profile and online dimension of multipartite geodesic convexity
